shared_elements: human or humanoid figure in profile with outstretched arm
large wing with rows of parallel feathers
low-relief carving of figures on a flat panel
raised arm gesture toward another element
justification: Both show low-relief profile human-form figures with an extended arm and heavily striated feather/ray patterning, but in A the striations belong to a great wing attached to a bearded figure while in B they are rays radiating from a central disc onto figures at an offering table. The specific iconography differs entirely: A is a single large winged genius-type figure filling the panel; B is a multi-figure scene with sun-disc, altar with vessels, attendants and dense columns of sign-writing, none of which appears in A.
